description: This file defines a PHP class 'ADODB_odbc' extending 'ADOConnection', providing an implementation for database connectivity and operations through the ODBC interface. It includes methods for connecting, querying, transaction management, and schema/metadata retrieval, specifically targeting ODBC data sources.

classes.name: ADODB_odbc
classes.description: A class managing ODBC database connections, queries, and schema metadata in PHP, extending ADOConnection.

classes.name: ADODBRecordSet_odbc
classes.description: A class representing result sets fetched via ODBC, providing methods for iterating, fetching fields, and managing data retrieval.

methods.name: _connect
methods.description: Establishes a connection to a data source using provided DSN, username, password.

methods.name: ServerInfo
methods.description: Retrieves server information, potentially using data source details.

methods.name: CreateSequence
methods.description: Creates a new sequence (auto-incrementing ID generator) in a specified table.

methods.name: GenID
methods.description: Generates a unique ID value from a sequence, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: ErrorMsg
methods.description: Returns the last error message from ODBC operations.

methods.name: ErrorNo
methods.description: Returns the last error code from ODBC operations.

methods.name: MetaPrimaryKeys
methods.description: Retrieves primary key columns for a specified table.

methods.name: MetaTables
methods.description: Retrieves list of table names, filtered by type if specified.

methods.name: MetaColumns
methods.description: Retrieves column metadata for a specified table.

methods.name: Prepare
methods.description: Prepares an SQL statement for execution, supporting parameter binding.

methods.name: _query
methods.description: Executes an SQL query, with optional parameter binding.

methods.name: UpdateBlob
methods.description: Updates a BLOB field in a table.

methods.name: _affectedrows
methods.description: Returns the number of rows affected by the last operation.
